findings.quote: By candlelight in the room at Hollins Hall, Hale turned back to Monday's page and read his own margin note through twice.
findings.claim: Hale lodges at Nether Scarrow, at the inn. Nothing has moved him, and Hollins Hall is the estate paying for the survey and steering where the bound falls. Putting the surveyor's bed inside it, silently, in a subordinate clause, gives away something the story has not decided to give away.
findings.fix: The same sentence in his room at the inn at Nether Scarrow.
findings.reference: bible/timeline.md, Day 1 — lodges at Nether Scarrow

findings.quote: Coulter held; Fowler drew the arrow and went on
findings.claim: Fowler is on the leading end. The leader sticks an arrow at each chain-length; the man behind pulls them up. As written the leader pulls an arrow up and walks forward.
findings.fix: Fowler sets the arrow and goes on; Coulter draws it as he comes up to it.
findings.reference: bible/world.md, ## Means — the chain worked by two chainmen

findings.quote: Fowler stopped and stood, and drew the last arrows out of the ground on his way back, and came and set them in Hale's palm without a word
findings.claim: The critic held that the following man should gather the arrows.

findings.quote: He struck out the longest and the shortest and the two that were left were eleven forty and ten ninety-six
findings.claim: Longest is twelve eleven, shortest is ten ninety-six. Striking those leaves eleven seventy-two and eleven forty. The sentence keeps the figure it has just struck out.
findings.fix: The survivors are eleven seventy-two and eleven forty.
findings.reference: the four figures the draft itself states

arbitration: Findings 1, 2 and 4 were upheld and patched. **Finding 3 was OVERRULED.** bible/characters.md states in Nat Fowler's own entry: 'He draws the arrows, sets them in Hale's palm, and lets the surveyor read the number off his own hand.' That gesture is canon and it is the one the whole survey turns on. The critic reached it by citing a previous chapter's prose rather than the Bible, and acting on it would have written an error into the book by hand. The overruled finding was carried into the feedback sheet anyway, marked as overruled and with an instruction not to act on it - LOOP-003 forbids trimming a finding from a sheet, and the writer left the sentence untouched.
resolution: Three literal substitutions supplied by the writer, all applied by exact match, none skipped, none of the quoted text surviving. Iteration 2 scored 10 with no findings and none marked late.
orchestrator_note: The arithmetic finding is the one worth noticing. The orchestrator had independently verified this chapter's four figures before dispatching the critics - that they were all distinct, that they summed to forty-six chains nineteen links and meant eleven chains fifty-five links - and did NOT check which two survived striking the extremes. The critic did. That is the gate earning its place.
